title: 2026 LA Food Tour Exploring America’s Culinary Frontier
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the heart of downtown Los Angeles on a flavor-packed, small-group walking adventure. Wander Chinatown’s vibrant streets, sample authentic bites in Little Tokyo, and explore historic Grand Central Market’s melting pot of tastes. Skip the hassle of traffic and crowded buses—your guide takes you to hidden local gems within easy walking distance of each other, sharing stories behind the city’s food culture as you taste your way through LA’s most diverse neighborhoods.
